query:
WITH released AS (
                    UPDATE pages
                    SET indexed = FALSE
                    WHERE indexed = TRUE
                        AND last_index_attempt_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND last_index_attempt_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $1)
                    RETURNING id
                )
                DELETE FROM page_word pw
                USING released
                WHERE pw.page_id = released.id
